set -eu

[Unit]
Description=OS comparison inventory worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-resource-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=1s
CPUAccounting=yes
CPUQuota=25%
MemoryAccounting=yes
MemoryMax=128M
MemorySwapMax=0
NoNewPrivileges=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
sha256sum /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
